generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The new method `getWatchHistory` includes a call to `flushAndRefresh` on the `.watcher-history-*` index, which can have performance implications if called frequently or in performance-sensitive tests. Consider whether this operation is necessary for all test cases or if it can be optimized.

The changes replace multiple instances of `assertBusy` with calls to a new method `getWatchHistory`. While this refactoring aims to improve code readability and reduce duplication, it introduces a dependency on the `ensureGreen` method within `getWatchHistory`, which might not be necessary in all contexts. Ensure that `ensureGreen` is appropriate for all test scenarios where `getWatchHistory` is used.

review_comment: `.setSize(...)` drops out here (and a few other places) -- is that okay?

Some places only needed the count (so size=0 was fine), and some wanted the single record (so size=1 was fine). Since we always expect either 0 or 1 documents in this index it didn't seem to cause any problems to just use the default size. Worst case, we pull back a single history document that we don't care about that gets immediately garbage collected. It avoided passing an argument into this method that might just add confusion.
